resource_scope: Total 1200-second watchdog includes handshake, setup, controls, seed generation and both interleaved transits; Windows kill-on-close job, sampled aggregate RSS and actual-worker OS peak, not a hard RSS allocation limit. All task-folder outputs except baseline/before-edit/source archive/validation plan count toward 64 MiB; job log has its own 1 MiB bound. Cleanup is separately bounded.
